entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation sprite atlas for this EXACT existing fantasy VTT character. Preserve face, hairstyle, facial hair, armor/clothes, original proportions, accessories and palette. Stow weapons. Crisp painted pixel sprite art matching the reference. EXACT EIGHT COLUMNS by SIX ROWS, 48 equal cells, landscape 4:3 canvas, transparent RGBA with no color halos. One complete character in each cell with generous padding. Constant body scale across ALL rows, common ground baseline in each cell. No floor, shadows, labels or grid. Eight genuinely incremental chronological poses per row, anatomically natural, no whole body sliding in stationary gestures. ROW1: HISTORY SUCCESS, holding a small rolled parchment in the left hand, turn from right-facing three-quarter to FACE THE CAMERA, smile, lift right fist triumphantly then give a clear THUMBS UP toward camera, eight small stages ending confident with thumb up. ROW2: HISTORY FAILURE, small rolled parchment left hand, right hand rises to scratch the back of head, puzzled look, scratch twice, shoulders lower, head droops into a visibly SAD sheepish final posture. Feet planted. ROW3: DECEPTION ESCAPE, wearing a jaunty green-brown feathered HAT integrated on the head. Eight distinct RUNNING TO THE RIGHT frames, full chronological gait cycle with contact/passing/airborne poses, no change of direction, hat stays on, no extra objects. ROW4: STEALTH, eight distinct tiptoe sneaking RIGHT frames, bent knees and low torso, carefully placing toes and then transferring weight, quiet natural gait. Face right throughout, no props. ROW5: RELIGIOUS BOOK STUDY, open leather BOOK physically held in hands: 0 read; 1 compare page while pointing right; 2 lift book proudly showing a drawn golden symbol on page; 3 respectful proud nod still holding book; 4 puzzled page turn; 5 realize book upside down and turn it; 6 loose pages flutter into face in a harmless visual mishap; 7 surprised confused face still holding book. ROW6: POISONOUS PLANT FAILURE, 0 kneeling examine; 1 inhale about to sneeze; 2 forceful sneeze into elbow; 3 recoil coughing with face and exposed SKIN turning muted PURPLE; 4 stagger backward arms balancing, purple face; 5 falling backward hands bracing; 6 land on back on the ground, feet near ground, eyes OPEN and woozy; 7 lying safely on back breathing, purple skin and embarrassed but unharmed face. Preserve clothes palette; only exposed skin tinted purple in final four poses. No blood, death or magic rewards. Entire raised arms and lying body fit each cell.

Create a transparent animation atlas in the EXACT same hand painted detailed 2D fantasy sprite art and character identities as the reference NPC sheet. EIGHT columns by SIX rows,48 separate full-body cells,4:3 landscape, no background, no floor, no shadow, no lettering, no UI, no panel lines. Keep characters fully inside each cell with margin, equal scale and shared planted baseline for each row. Different incremental poses, readable hands and feet.
Row1 same armored guard. Cells0,1 surprised looking LEFT and starting turn. Cells2..7 SIX smooth running gait poses facing RIGHT in ALL six frames, pursuing someone out of frame. No left-facing frames in run.
Row2 same leather-clad bandit. Cells0,1 frightened facing LEFT then turning. Cells2..7 SIX smooth terrified running gait frames facing RIGHT in ALL six, arms pumping, no left-facing frames.
Row3 GROUP of THREE adult HUMAN audience members in EVERY cell, equal physical human scale, one tall woman, two men, rustic clothing. Eight cheering poses: some clap with feet on ground, one jumps with joy; at least one is always grounded for baseline. Same group, positions, scale, lively smiles.
Row4 worried human traveler holding a folded LETTER integrally in hands. Cell0 clutches letter down,1 wipes eyes,2 looks up anxiously,3 explains nervously with hand,4 opens letter to show actual concern,5 visibly relieved nod and warm grateful smile,6 withdraws letter and covers face sadly,7 turns away shoulders hunched. These last two should clearly show closing off instead of relief.
Row5 same sleepy armored guard.0 dozing,1 snoring,2 stretch and yawn,3 rub eyes,4 sudden alarm looking LEFT,5 points LEFT,6 steps LEFT,7 suspicious looking LEFT.
Row6 SAME group of THREE HUMAN audience members from row3, full-size adults: eight WALKING RIGHT gait poses leaving disappointed, all facing RIGHT, consistent clothes and proportions. No hero, no captions, transparent alpha.

A transparent hand-painted 2D fantasy game sprite atlas matching the reference's polished illustrated VTT art. EXACT EIGHT columns by THREE rows,24 equal separated cells, very wide landscape. No shadows, no background or floor, no text/UI/halo/grid. Keep entire creature inside each cell and clear margin, same scale and baseline within each row.
Row1 one small green goblin in patched leather and simple cap, expressive large ears: cell0 idle looking LEFT,1 startled glances LEFT; cells2..7 SIX consecutive smooth RUNNING RIGHT gait drawings. In every running cell nose, body, feet point RIGHT.
Row2 one small red-brown kobold in rustic leather tunic, long snout and tail, original fantasy creature:0idleLEFT,1startledLEFT,2..7 SIX smooth RUN RIGHT gait frames, snout and all movement right consistently, tail behind left.
Row3 one gray-brown mouse:0sniffs left,1alertleft,2..7 SIX SCURRY RIGHT frames, head ALWAYS right,tailleft,full mouse including whiskers and tail. No equipment.
Distinct full-body drawings, readable real anatomy, rich but muted material colors, thin painterly edges, genuine transparent alpha.

Identity-preserving transparent VTT 2D animation sprite sheet. EXACT EIGHT COLUMNS by THREE ROWS,24 wide cells,very wide landscape. Each cell is a COMPLETE PAIRED scene of TWO full-body characters at SAME baseline. The adventurer always LEFT, distracted human traveler always RIGHT,facing RIGHT. Preserve EXACT original hero faces, clothes, palette,gear,body proportions from references. No floor,background,shadows,text,borders.
Row1 hero is red-haired female dwarf Mía (reference1), physical short dwarf, human traveler taller, both fully visible.
Row2 hero is blue-robed elderly wizard Mike (reference2), human-scale height same as traveler.
Row3 hero is small curly-haired halfling Trinity(reference3), clearly shorter than human traveler.
For EACH row, eight different incremental poses show a readable pickpocket demonstration, same positions and scale throughout:
0 hero leans in toward unsuspecting traveler's BACK RIGHT HIP pocket, hands still at own chest.
1 hero carefully extends right arm toward real pocket, left hand behind.
2 fingers clearly ENTER POCKET.
3 draws out a large reddish brown coin POUCH from pocket, pouch IN HERO HAND.
4 SUCCESS: hero steps back slightly and discreetly shows the LARGE POUCH,traveler still looks away RIGHT unaware.
5 alternate FAILURE: hero's hand still at pocket,the traveler twists head LEFT and notices.
6 failure traveler catches hero's WRIST and points at the pocket accusingly, clear genuine contact anatomy, no merged arms.
7 hero withdraws sheepishly, open empty palms, traveler stern with hand covering own pouch.
No disconnected floating pouches or attached separate props. Same simple green-cloak traveler identity acrossallrows. All hands and objects painted as part of the integrated paired drawing. No violence. Grounded feet, consistent scale, sharp readable gestures, polished painted fantasy game sprites.

Identity preserving polished illustrated 2D VTT animation atlas. EXACT EIGHT COLUMNS by SIX ROWS,48 equal cells,landscape4:3. Transparent background with no floor,shadows,UI,text,grid. Each cell TWO complete characters with both full bodies and feet visible. Protagonist LEFT, same rustic HUMAN patient RIGHT on small stool, same positions and fixed shared baseline. Preserve EXACT faces, outfit, body proportions and material colors from the references, do not change race, sex or costume. Small harmless red cut on patient's LEFT forearm, small blood stain exactly there, never gore.
Rows1,2 use reference1 hero red-haired bearded armored DWARF (short; patient adult human taller).
Rows3,4 use reference2 hero long pale-haired ELF in blue gold-trimmed robe (human-height).
Rows5,6 use reference3 hero small curly brown-haired HALFLING (patient clearly taller).
Every ODD row is eight incremental SUCCESS stages:0 examine injured forearm,1 prepare linen roll in hero's hands,2 place bandage directly on cut,3 wind neatly,4 finish tying,5 patient gently tests covered arm,6 patient STANDS UP from stool showing bandaged arm,7 both smiling/waving gratefully, patient standing. Keep patient same adult size when standing; change pose not scale.
Every EVEN row alternate FAILURE stages:0 examine,1 linen roll in hands,2 linen catches hero fingers,3 wraps hero forearms accidentally,4 patient gently helps unloop linen,5 patient carefully unwinds bandage,6 hero hands finally free still holding linen roll,7 both sheepishly laughing together, patient seated with cut still visible. Do not magically heal, no glow, no floating props. All actual bandages held and wrapped in the drawing, genuine hand/arm contact, readable small expressive faces. Fullbody throughout, consistent scale, no dismemberment.

Two game environment sprite assets on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. EXACT TWO COLUMNS by ONE ROW, each cell one complete long narrow horizontal trail, separate with large blank gap and no intersection. Wide landscape image. Painted fantasy VTT art matching reference stone floor: muted charcoal blue-green slate and dry brown earth, warm amber rim light, detailed but readable at smallsize, no text,noUI,no frame,no glow ring,no characters,no grass tufts.
LEFT cell: a path of SIX very clear WILD BOAR HOOFPRINTS impressed into a small subtle patch of dark soil on flat slate ground. Each hoofprint has TWO adjacent wide blunt teardrop halves with a DEEP SPLIT between them plus TWO small rounded DEWCLAW marks behind. Alternating left/right gait, progressing horizontally to the RIGHT. Hoofprints large and deeply indented, warm subtle rim catches light. Easily recognizable animal cloven hoofprints, NOT human boots,NOT paw pads. Preserve six distinct prints.
RIGHT cell: separate trail of SIX DEER HOOFPRINTS, narrower pointed split double almond shapes, no dewclaws, alternating gait moving diagonally up-right within small horizontal ground patch.
Both assets seen from shallow top-down isometric floor perspective so they LIE FLAT on a side-view game platform. Long flat ground decals, not vertical walls or upright objects. Edges of tiny soil/stone patches fade naturally to transparent alpha; background entirely transparent. No castshadows under the prints because they are impressions INTO the floor.

Preserve the EXACT identity, face, costume, proportions and colors of each reference hero. Transparent polished painted fantasy VTT sprite atlas, EXACT EIGHT COLUMNS by THREE ROWS,24separate fullbody cells,very wide landscape. No floor,background,shadow,halo,text,grid. Identical scale and ground baseline in each row, keep fullbody and accessories inside cells with margins.
Row1 same red-haired BEARDED armored DWARF from reference1.
Row2 same long pale-haired pointed-ear ELF in blue gold-trimmed robe from reference2.
Row3 same small curly-haired HALFLING from reference3.
EACH ROW is EIGHT smooth incremental WALKING RIGHT gait drawings while hero carries a rolled ivory PARCHMENT scroll physically gripped in LEFT hand at chest, right arm balancing a little. All frames face RIGHT, no turn toward viewer,no leftfacing,no running. Small realistic deliberate steps, clear alternating heel-contact, weight transfer, push-off, swing and landing, front/back legs visibly alternate. Parchment stays IN LEFT HAND in every pose, painted integrally with fingers and forearm. Preserve original armor,belts,boots and cloak. Do NOT add hats. Do NOT change faces. This walking sequence links a reading pose to a stationary front-facing thumbs up after approach. Eight DIFFERENT gait drawings per hero, no duplicate still poses, no floating feet.
